description: Updates the specified hazard. Procore-provided hazard names cannot be changed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the hazard. Use the id from the List Hazards response.

name.description: Display name of the hazard, translated to the requested locale. For the untranslated original name, see name_key.

name_key.description: Untranslated original name of the hazard. Use for programmatic matching when locale-independent identification is needed.

active.description: Whether this hazard is active and available for selection when recording incidents.

global.description: Whether this hazard is a Procore-provided default. Global hazards cannot be renamed or deleted.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hazard was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hazard was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

name.description: Display name of the hazard. Must be unique within the company. Cannot be changed for Procore-provided hazards.

active.description: Whether the hazard is available for selection when recording incidents.
